#+BEGIN_SRC sh :results output
# allow ssh from the lab VLAN only
nft add rule inet filter input ip saddr 10.0.20.0/24 tcp dport 22 accept
nft list ruleset | grep -c accept
#+END_SRC

** Glossary

- VLAN :: a virtual LAN that splits one switch into many
- MTU :: the largest frame a link will carry
- Trunk port ::
  A port that carries tagged traffic for several VLANs.
